newsitem.title: EU: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 82 OF MARCH 22, 1997.
newsitem.headline: OFFICIAL JOURNAL CONTENTS - OJ L 82 OF MARCH 22, 1997.

text.p: (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)
COMMISSION DECISION of 20 March 1997 amending Decision 97/116/EC concerning certain protection measures relating to classical swine fever in Germany (Text with EEA relevance)
COMMISSION DECISION of 19 March 1997 on marking and use of pigmeat in application of Article 9 of Council Directive 80/217/EEC concerning the Netherlands (Text with EEA relevance)

COMMISSION DECISION of 4 March 1997 recognizing that the production of certain quality wines in specified regions and of certain 'local wines' in Greece is, by reason of their qualitative characteristics, far from able to satisfy demand (Only the Greek text is authentic)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 532/97 of 21 March 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 531/97 of 21 March 1997 on a tendering procedure for the subsidy on the export of husked long grain rice to Reunion
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 530/97 of 21 March 1997 on an invitation to tender for the refund on export of wholly milled long grain rice to certain third countries
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 529/97 of 21 March 1997 opening and administering a tariff quota of 300 000 tonnes of quality wheat and repealing Regulation (EC) No 1854/94

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 528/97 of 21 March 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 584/92 laying down detailed rules for the application to milk and milk products of the arrangements provided for in the Europe Agreements between the Community and the Republic of Poland, the Republic of Hungary, the Czech Republic and the Slovak Republic

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 527/97 of 21 March 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1725/92 laying down detailed implementing rules for the specific measures for supplying the Azores and Madeira with products from the pigmeat sector and fixing the aid for products coming from the Community
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 526/97 of 21 March 1997 fixing the refunds applicable to cereal and rice sector products supplied as Community and national food aid

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 525/97 of 21 March 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 1487/95 establishing the supply balance for the Canary Islands for products from the pigmeat sector and fixing the aid for products coming from the Community
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 524/97 of 21 March 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1627/89 on the buying in of beef by invitation to tender
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 523/97 of 21 March 1997 fixing the export refunds on rice and broken rice
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 522/97 of 21 March 1997 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of rice products from the Community to the Canary Islands
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 521/97 of 21 March 1997 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of rice products from the Community to the Azores and Madeira
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 520/97 of 21 March 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1832/92 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of cereals products from the Community to the Canary Islands
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 519/97 of 21 March 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 1833/92 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of cereals products from the Community to the Azores and Madeira

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 518/97 of 21 March 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 391/92 setting the amounts of aid for the supply of cereals products from the Community to the French overseas departments
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 517/97 of 21 March 1997 on the application of a minimum price for certain soft fruits originating in Poland
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 516/97 of 21 March 1997 on the supply of milk products as food aid

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 515/97 of 13 March 1997 on mutual assistance between the administrative authorities of the Member States and cooperation between the latter and the Commission to ensure the correct application of the law on customs and agricultural matters

Corrigendum to Commission Regulation (EC) No 2190/96 of 14 November 1996 on detailed rules for implementing Council Regulation (EEC) No 1035/72 as regards export refunds on fruit and vegetables (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 292 of 15 November 1996) END OF DOCUMENT.
